text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "24-Hour Live Forest-Watching Channel"… What a novel idea for a live stream.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It's a shame the camera is fixed on a single location, but it's a blessing to be able to observe the forest any time I please.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Even through the screen… I can make out the whispering of the evening breeze and the hooting of the Pointy-Brows.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. As daybreak approaches, the trees are becoming easier to make out as well.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah… I suppose that means morning has come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Entranced by the live stream, Yamanin Zephyr ends up staying awake until the early hours.
